identity.real_world_identity_notes: IMSA GTP prototype developed with Lola (T710 chassis) and Chevrolet power; despite the Corvette nameplate it shares little with the road car. Raced in IMSA GT from 1985 to 1989 and uses a Hewland VGC five-speed H-pattern racing gearbox. Live testing confirmed H-pattern actuation requiring the clutch for a standing start, a throttle lift to upshift, and a manual blip to downshift, with no automatic cut or blip. 'Low Downforce' is an aero-package alias inheriting the verified base controls and was not separately live-tested.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.
